Pilot · Russia

Damir Yusupov

Ural Airlines Flight 1782019
Flight
Ural Airlines Flight 178
Date
15 August 2019
Aircraft
Airbus A321
Location
Near Zhukovsky, Moscow region
Survivors
233 of 233 aboard

After bird strikes damaged both engines just after takeoff near Moscow, he landed the Airbus A321 in a cornfield. All 233 people aboard survived.
